pocket-base-2x1x4.title: Pocket box base 2x1x4
pocket-base-2x1x4.blurb: Carry box with Stakee feet: 16 mm deep inside, three hinge knuckles at the back, a snap tab at the front. Closed with its lid it stacks like a 2x1x4 crate.
pocket-base-2x1x4.material: PETG (the latch tab flexes; PLA tabs crack)
pocket-base-2x1x4.print_notes: Upright on its feet, no supports: the knuckles and the back recess are chamfered 45 deg. 4 walls so the 1.6 mm tab is solid perimeters. Optional 6x2 mm magnets.

pocket-lid-2x1.title: Pocket box lid 2x1
pocket-lid-2x1.blurb: Hinged lid with two knuckles at the back, a notch the latch clicks into, a full stacking lip on top and a label recess in its floor.
pocket-lid-2x1.print_notes: On its flat underside, no supports (knuckle chamfers 45 deg). Hinge: push a 82.5 mm length of 1.75 mm filament through all five knuckles from one side.

pocket-divider-2x1.title: Pocket box divider 2x1
pocket-divider-2x1.blurb: Plate for the slots at x = 21 mm: a cable bay beside the board.
